entities.summary: Janet Fitch is an American author. She wrote the novel White Oleander, which became a film in 2002. She is a graduate of Reed College. Janet Fitch was a authors & novelists from Los Angeles (b. 1955-11-09, Los Angeles). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Created literary works of enduring influence.
